fixed_twin_defects.symptom: After the Shared PROCESSED enqueue failure, HandleFailedMessage republishes to the retry topic; provider.GetKafkaProducerProvider returns a nil interface because the container cannot build a producer against ["broker:9092","broker1:9092"] (getter.go:161-166, container.go:110-113). The nil is unchecked and the processMessages goroutine has no recover, so payouts-kafka-fts-status-updates-consumer panics at taskHandlers/fts_status_updates.go:105 and exits 2. The next scenario (Direct-after-Shared) then times out with no consumer group member. Reproduced at reports/implementation/runs/claude-audit-kafka-repro-20260905T152544Z/.
fixed_twin_defects.title: payouts [kafka_producer].Brokers carried the upstream dummy, crashing the Kafka consumer on any failed message

fixed_twin_defects.symptom: rand_password mapped base64 '+' to '-', so roughly one boot in 32 produced a Mongo root password beginning with '-'. mongosh treated it as an option, printed its usage text and the seeds step aborted, so the whole boot failed (retained: reports/implementation/runs/m1-20260905T165255Z/profile-kafka-failed-boot/up.log). Intermittent, secret-dependent boot failure; no service behaviour involved.
